Jose: hey @channel seeing a 404 from the KB link in the runtime guide -> https://kb.redwood.dev/s/rt-compiler returns 404. Anyone own that page?
DocsBot: Link health scan flagged https://kb.redwood.dev/s/rt-compiler as 404 at 2026-03-17T10:15Z :warning:
Liz: Im the runtime guide owner but OOO until tomorrow. If its a quick redirect someone else can patch it? :wave:
Harry: I can take a look. Is it a missing file or a moved page? :eyes:
Jose: looks like the runtime page links to `/guides/compile-optimizations.md` but that file was moved to `/guides/compiler-optimizations-v2.md` last month. Quick fix is just to update the link in runtime/intro.md.
Jose: ```diff
- [compiler optimizations](/guides/compile-optimizations.md)
+ [compiler optimizations](/guides/compiler-optimizations-v2.md)
```
Kevin: put up a quick MR: https://git.redwood.dev/redwood/docs/-/merge_requests/459 (draft). PTAL @Liz @Harry. CI will run linkcheck on push.
DocsBot: linkcheck queued for MR 459 :runner:
Harry: :thumbsup: Ill review once CI finishes. If linkcheck complains we can add a CDN redirect as a short-term fallback.
Jose: if folks want a one-line redirect we usually add to `netlify/_redirects`:
`/guides/compile-optimizations.md  /guides/compiler-optimizations-v2.md  301`
sre-oncall: cc @sre-oncall — we can surface a temporary CDN redirect but prefer keeping redirects in repo so docs history remains consistent. happy to assist with deploy if needed.
Liz: back online, thanks for the ping. LGTM on the fix. @Kevin please squash & merge after CI green.
Kevin: merged and deployed, MR 459 -> merged. shortlink resolves now :rocket:
DocsBot: link health scan re-run: no 404s detected for /guides/compile-optimizations.md.
Jose: thanks team — closing the loop!
